statements.label: I
statements.text: In prokaryotes, the positively charged DNA is held with some negatively charged proteins in a region called nucleoid.

statements.label: II
statements.text: In eukaryotes, the negatively charged DNA is wrapped around the positively charged histone octamer to form nucleosome.

options_en.1: Both Statement I and Statement II are true.
options_en.2: Both Statement I and Statement II are false.
options_en.3: Statement I is correct but Statement II is false.
options_en.4: Statement I incorrect but Statement II is true.
